title: AppearanceOpportunity
description: The central aggregate of the HOSPES system. An AppearanceOpportunity represents one specific attempt to book one Person onto one Show for one proposed episode. Because a single person can decline in one year, accept a different project the next, appear on multiple shows, or return as a recurring guest, the Person and the Opportunity are separate records. One Person may have many AppearanceOpportunities — across shows, across years, as a solo guest or part of a group. The state machine on this object is the canonical pipeline tracker that prevents duplicate outreach, lost follow-ups, and broken promises.

opportunity_id.description: Stable UUID for this specific booking attempt.

guest_id.description: Opaque cross-season guest identity, scoped to one tenant and show. Every guest_history row and every do-not-contact directive keys on it, so a guest carries one memory across seasons even though each season is a separate opportunity.

season.description: Short season label this opportunity belongs to (for example 'S3'). A terminal decision writes it into the guest's cross-season memory.

episode.description: Short episode label within the season (for example 'E5').

do_not_contact.description: Projected live directive for this guest identity. True refuses import, draft preview, draft persistence, and outreach receipts.

guest_history_badge.description: Rendered memory badge for the approval card, for example 'Previously: S2E3 — SOFT_DECLINE (2024-03-15)'. Null when the guest has no prior season.

show_id.description: The Show this opportunity belongs to.

episode_id.description: Linked Episode record once one is created. Null until BOOKED or later.

state.description: Current pipeline state. See states.json for the canonical state set and legal transitions.

why_guest.description: One-paragraph editorial case for why this person is a fit for the show. Specific, not generic praise.

why_now.description: Why this invitation is timely — a recent project, event, tension, or cultural moment.

episode_thesis.description: The proposed central question or claim the episode would explore. Required before state advances past QUALIFIED.

proposed_artifact.description: The object, document, or physical thing the guest would bring to the episode (per the show's segment design).

relationship_class.description: Relationship class at the time this opportunity was created. C4–C5 block all automated outreach and require explicit host approval.

route.description: contact_route_id of the selected outreach route for this opportunity.

contact_roster_refs.description: Public-safe contact roster projection. Raw names, addresses, phone numbers, and notes are excluded; authorized operators use the private roster endpoint for transient reveal.

social_cost.description: Estimated social cost of pursuing this opportunity through the selected route. System recommends the least expensive credible path, not the most likely immediate yes.

ari_effort.description: How much of Ari's personal social capital this opportunity requires. Drives the morning approval queue.

city.description: Guest's home or current city. Drives studio routing and touring-guest interception.

studio_id.description: Studio assigned for this recording. Null until SCHEDULING or later.

relationship_path.description: Narrative description of the proposed outreach path and any warm-introduction chain.

assigned_owner.description: person_id of the team member responsible for driving this opportunity forward.

next_action.description: Human-readable description of the next concrete action required.

next_action_at.description: When the next action is due. Triggers FOLLOW_UP_DUE state or a heartbeat alert.

source_provenance.description: How this opportunity was surfaced (e.g. 'RSS archive ingest', 'Ari suggestion', 'producer research', 'referral from [person]').

editorial_fit_score.description: Optional numeric editorial fit score (0–100). Auto-generated; not a binding filter.

estimated_booking_probability.description: Optional probability estimate (0.0–1.0). Auto-generated; informational only.

decline_reason.description: Reason for decline if state is DECLINED. Preserved for future re-evaluation.

revisit_after.description: If state is REVISIT_LATER, the date after which this opportunity should be reconsidered.
